CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_enrichment_candidate(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when public.icash_dealmachine_capacity_available(2,p_account) and public.icash_owner_active_export_capacity(p_account) in ('disabled','ready') then public.icash_enrichment_before_provider_quota(p_account) else null::uuid end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_resume_prospecting_ticket()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare t public.icash_automation_tickets;op text;
begin
 perform 1 from public.icash_operating_budget where id=1 and enabled for update;
 if not found then return null;end if;
 for t in
  with waiting_accounts as materialized (
   select distinct account_id from public.icash_automation_tickets
   where state='held' and outcome='prospecting_budget_held' and expires_at<=now()
  ), allowances as materialized (
   select a.id,public.icash_prospecting_available(a.id) available
   from public.icash_accounts a join waiting_accounts w on w.account_id=a.id
   where not a.bot_paused and public.icash_membership_work_allowed(a.id)
  ), outreach_priority as materialized (
   select a.*,case when exists(
    select 1 from public.icash_automation_tickets pending where pending.account_id=a.id
     and pending.state='held' and pending.outcome='prospecting_budget_held' and pending.expires_at<=now()
     and pending.kind in ('contacts','discovery') and a.available>=pending.prospecting_quote_cents
   ) then (icash_work_private.warm_seller_due(a.id) or public.icash_research_waiting_on_outreach(a.id)) else false end waiting_for_outreach
   from allowances a
  )
  select x.* from public.icash_automation_tickets x join outreach_priority a on a.id=x.account_id
  where x.state='held' and x.outcome='prospecting_budget_held' and x.expires_at<=now()
  and a.available>=x.prospecting_quote_cents
  and (x.kind<>'voice_dispatch' or exists(
   select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs v
   join public.icash_voice_contact_targets current_target
    on current_target.id=coalesce(v.permission_id,v.operational_contact_id) and current_target.account_id=v.account_id
   where v.id=x.voice_job_id and v.account_id=x.account_id
    and ((v.permission_id is not null and v.operational_contact_id is null and current_target.eligibility_source='operator_record')
     or (v.permission_id is null and v.operational_contact_id is not null and current_target.eligibility_source='operational_checks_only'))
    and current_target.revoked_at is null and current_target.permission_until>now()
    and (public.icash_outreach_window_open(current_target.timezone,
     case when v.operational_contact_id is not null then (select timezone_basis from public.icash_operational_contacts
      where id=v.operational_contact_id and account_id=v.account_id and channel='voice') end,clock_timestamp()) or public.icash_owner_demo_call_current(v.account_id,v.id))
  ))
  and (x.kind not in ('contacts','discovery') or (public.icash_acquisition_capacity_available(x.account_id) and not a.waiting_for_outreach))
  and (x.kind<>'contacts' or public.icash_owner_active_export_capacity(x.account_id) in ('disabled','ready'))

  and (x.kind='discovery' or (
   x.kind in ('contacts','voice_dispatch','seller_opener','seller_recovery')
   and (x.kind<>'contacts' or x.screening_id is not null)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_automation_tickets active
    where active.id<>x.id and active.account_id=x.account_id
     and ((active.state='issued' and active.expires_at>now())
      or (active.state='consumed' and active.created_at>now()-interval '5 minutes')))
   and (x.kind<>'voice_dispatch' or exists(select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs v
    where v.id=x.voice_job_id and v.account_id=x.account_id and v.state='held' and v.outcome='prospecting_budget_held'
     and v.operation_key is null and v.conversation_id is null and v.provider_call_sid is null))
   and (x.kind not in ('seller_opener','seller_recovery') or exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_messages m
    where m.id=x.opener_message_id and m.account_id=x.account_id and m.state='ready' and m.provider_id is null and m.last_delivery_at is null))
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_operation_spend spent where spent.operation_key=case
    when x.kind='contacts' then 'owners:'||x.account_id||':'||x.screening_id
    when x.kind='voice_dispatch' then 'voice:'||x.voice_job_id else 'text:'||x.opener_message_id end)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_live_conversations live where live.operation_key=case
    when x.kind='contacts' then 'owners:'||x.account_id||':'||x.screening_id
    when x.kind='voice_dispatch' then 'voice:'||x.voice_job_id else 'text:'||x.opener_message_id end)
  ))
  order by x.created_at limit 20 for update of x skip locked loop
  op:=null;
  if t.kind='contacts' then op:='owners:'||t.account_id||':'||t.screening_id;
  elsif t.kind='voice_dispatch' then
   op:='voice:'||t.voice_job_id;
   if not exists(select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs where id=t.voice_job_id and account_id=t.account_id and state='held' and outcome='prospecting_budget_held' and operation_key is null and conversation_id is null and provider_call_sid is null) then continue;end if;
  elsif t.kind in ('seller_opener','seller_recovery') then
   op:='text:'||t.opener_message_id;
   if not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_messages where id=t.opener_message_id and account_id=t.account_id and state='ready' and provider_id is null and last_delivery_at is null) then continue;end if;
  elsif t.kind='discovery' then
   -- A discovery page can move independently. Its scheduler handles the current
   -- revision; do not replay a stale page capability.
   update public.icash_automation_tickets set outcome='prospecting_budget_released' where id=t.id;
   perform public.icash_wake_funded_outreach(t.account_id);continue;
  end if;
  if op is null or exists(select 1 from public.icash_operation_spend where operation_key=op) or exists(select 1 from public.icash_live_conversations where operation_key=op) then continue;end if;
  if exists(select 1 from public.icash_automation_tickets x where x.id<>t.id and x.account_id=t.account_id and ((x.state='issued' and x.expires_at>now()) or (x.state='consumed' and x.created_at>now()-interval '5 minutes'))) then continue;end if;
  if t.kind='voice_dispatch' then update public.icash_voice_jobs set state='issued',outcome=null,updated_at=now() where id=t.voice_job_id;end if;
  update public.icash_automation_tickets set token=gen_random_uuid()::text||gen_random_uuid()::text,state='issued',outcome=null,completed_at=null,created_at=now(),expires_at=now()+interval '2 minutes' where id=t.id returning * into t;
  return jsonb_build_object('token',t.token);
 end loop;
 return null;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_owner_preflight_due_at(p_account uuid, p_screening uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with candidates as materialized (
  select p.id,p.account_id,p.items,p.state,p.checked_at,p.next_check_at
  from icash_research_private.owner_export_preflights p
  where p.account_id=p_account and (
   (p.state='waiting' and p.created_at>now()-interval '30 minutes' and p.created_at<=now()
    and p.next_check_at<=now() and p.deleted_at is null and p.cleanup_attempts=0)
   or (p.state='ready' and p.checked_at>now()-interval '30 minutes' and p.checked_at<=now()))
   and (p_screening is null or p.items->0->>'screeningId'=p_screening::text)
   and exists (
    select 1 from public.icash_screening_jobs s
    join public.icash_automation_tickets t on t.screening_id=s.id and t.account_id=s.account_id
    where s.id=(p.items->0->>'screeningId')::uuid and s.account_id=p.account_id
     and t.kind='contacts' and t.state='held' and t.outcome='owner_preview_rate_limited'
     and t.owner_preview_deferrals between 1 and 7
     and t.owner_preview_retry_after<=now() and t.owner_preview_retry_until>now()
   )
 ), due as materialized (
  select p.account_id,p.items,case when p.state='ready' then p.checked_at else p.next_check_at end next_check_at
  from candidates p
  where case when p.state='ready' then icash_research_private.owner_preflight_ready_current(p.id) else true end
   and icash_research_private.owner_preflight_list_known(p.id)
 )
 select min(p.next_check_at) from due p
 join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=(p.items->0->>'screeningId')::uuid and s.account_id=p.account_id
 join public.icash_automation_tickets t on t.screening_id=s.id and t.account_id=s.account_id
 where public.icash_dealmachine_capacity_available(3,p_account)
  and t.kind='contacts' and t.state='held' and t.outcome='owner_preview_rate_limited'
  and t.owner_preview_deferrals between 1 and 7
  and t.owner_preview_retry_after<=now() and t.owner_preview_retry_until>now()
  and t.owner_preview_screening_hash=public.icash_owner_enrichment_screening_hash(s)
  and public.icash_owner_enrichment_retry_current(s.account_id,s.id)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_operation_spend o
   join public.icash_screening_jobs prior on o.operation_key='owners:'||s.account_id||':'||prior.id
   where prior.account_id=s.account_id and prior.snapshot->>'propertyId'=s.snapshot->>'propertyId'
    and o.state in ('reserved','dispatched'))
  and p.items=icash_research_private.owner_preflight_cohort(s.account_id,s.id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_enrichment_before_provider_quota(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select public.icash_enrichment_before_prospecting_budget(p_account) from public.icash_discovery_configs c
 join public.icash_operation_rates r on r.id=c.contact_rate_id where c.account_id=p_account
  and not public.icash_research_waiting_on_outreach(p_account)
  and public.icash_prospecting_available(p_account)>=public.icash_research_admission_quote(p_account,'owner_enrichment',r.charge_cents);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_owner_active_export_capacity()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when not coalesce(public.icash_owner_active_export_enabled(),false) then 'disabled'
  when (exists(select 1 from icash_research_private.owner_exports where terminal_at is null and capacity_review_id is null) or icash_research_private.unknown_export_late_capacity_blocked()) then 'export_busy'
  when not public.icash_dealmachine_capacity_available(3) then 'quota_wait'
  else 'ready' end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_owner_active_export_capacity(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when not coalesce(public.icash_owner_active_export_enabled(),false) then 'disabled'
  when (exists(select 1 from icash_research_private.owner_exports where terminal_at is null and capacity_review_id is null) or icash_research_private.unknown_export_late_capacity_blocked()) then 'export_busy'
  when not public.icash_dealmachine_capacity_available(3,p_account) then 'quota_wait'
  else 'ready' end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_take_dealmachine_request()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 return icash_research_private.take_reserved_request(null,null,null,null);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_take_dealmachine_request(p_kind text, p_account uuid, p_operation text, p_request uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_request is null then return false;end if;
 return icash_research_private.take_reserved_request(p_kind,p_account,p_operation,p_request);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_research_private.owner_preflight_cohort(p_account uuid, p_primary uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p.items from icash_research_private.owner_export_preflights p
 where p.account_id=p_account and p.items->0->>'screeningId'=p_primary::text
 and ((p.state='ready' and p.checked_at>now()-interval '30 minutes' and p.checked_at<=now()
  and icash_research_private.owner_preflight_ready_current(p.id))
 or (p.state<>'ready' and (p.created_at>now()-interval '5 minutes' or
 (p.created_at>now()-interval '30 minutes' and p.state in ('waiting','checking','ready') and (icash_research_private.owner_preflight_list_known(p.id)))))) and p.state in ('creating','waiting','checking','ready')
 and (p.state='ready' or (p.deleted_at is null and p.cleanup_attempts=0))
 and exists(select 1 from icash_research_private.owner_export_settings where id=1 and enabled and preflight_enabled)
 and not exists(
  select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p.items) i
  left join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=(i->>'screeningId')::uuid and s.account_id=p_account
  where s.id is null or s.snapshot is distinct from i->'snapshot' or s.state is distinct from 'complete'
   or (s.completed_at between now()-interval '24 hours' and now()) is distinct from true
   or s.result->'financialCheck'->>'status' is distinct from 'eligible' or s.snapshot ? 'sellerRequest'
   or s.snapshot->>'propertyType' is distinct from 'house'
   or public.icash_research_state_allowed(s.snapshot->'raw'->'data'->>'state') is distinct from true
   or coalesce(p.request->'mobile_only','false'::jsonb) is distinct from to_jsonb(public.icash_owner_targeting_pool(p_account,s.id)='mobile')
   or public.icash_owner_enrichment_unstarted(p_account,s.id,'owners:'||p_account||':'||s.id) is distinct from true
   or exists(select 1 from public.icash_property_controls pc where pc.account_id=p_account and pc.property_id=s.snapshot->>'propertyId' and pc.manual)
   or (s.id<>p_primary and exists(select 1 from public.icash_automation_tickets t where t.screening_id=s.id))
 )
 and public.icash_owner_export_people_available(p.request->'people_ids')
 order by p.created_at,p.id limit 1;
$function$
